## Barplots of FEI and SFEI 
```{r}
#| label: fei-sfei-species-histograms
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| fig-width: 14
#| fig-height: 6

#======================
# SPECIES-LEVEL FEI AND SFEI BAR PLOTS
#======================

# Prepare data
plot_data <- SFEI_results %>%
  filter(!is.na(SFEI), !is.na(IUCN), !is.na(FEI_observed))

# Define IUCN labels and colors
iucn_labels <- c("1" = "LC", "2" = "NT", "3" = "VU", "4" = "EN", "5" = "CR")
iucn_colors <- c(
  "LC" = "#38AB38",
  "NT" = "#58AFFF", 
  "VU" = "#FEC748",
  "EN" = "#FC7F3F",
  "CR" = "#D81E05"
)

plot_data <- plot_data %>%
  mutate(IUCN_label = factor(iucn_labels[as.character(IUCN)], 
                              levels = c("LC", "NT", "VU", "EN", "CR")))

# --- 1. FEI bar plot (species ordered by increasing FEI) ---
fei_bar_data <- plot_data %>%
  arrange(FEI_observed) %>%
  mutate(species_order = row_number())

fei_barplot <- ggplot(fei_bar_data, aes(x = species_order, y = FEI_observed, fill = IUCN_label)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = iucn_colors, name = "IUCN Status") +
  labs(
    title = "Fishing Exposure Index (FEI)",
    x = "Species",
    y = "FEI (log fishing hours)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

# --- 1. FEI bar plot (species ordered by increasing FEI) ---
fei_bar_data <- plot_data %>%
  arrange(FEI_observed) %>%
  mutate(species_order = row_number())

# Get x-axis range for rectangles
n_species <- nrow(fei_bar_data)

# Calculate n and % per FEI category
n_low <- sum(fei_bar_data$FEI_observed <= 4)
n_moderate <- sum(fei_bar_data$FEI_observed > 4 & fei_bar_data$FEI_observed <= 5.5)
n_high <- sum(fei_bar_data$FEI_observed > 5.5 & fei_bar_data$FEI_observed <= 7)
n_veryhigh <- sum(fei_bar_data$FEI_observed > 7)

pct_low <- round(100 * n_low / n_species, 1)
pct_moderate <- round(100 * n_moderate / n_species, 1)
pct_high <- round(100 * n_high / n_species, 1)
pct_veryhigh <- round(100 * n_veryhigh / n_species, 1)

fei_barplot <- ggplot(fei_bar_data, aes(x = species_order, y = FEI_observed, fill = IUCN_label)) +
  # Background panels for FEI categories
  annotate("rect", xmin = 0.5, xmax = n_species + 0.5, ymin = 0, ymax = 4, 
           fill = "#77dd77", alpha = 0.5) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 0.5, xmax = n_species + 0.5, ymin = 4, ymax = 5.5, 
           fill = "#fdfd96", alpha = 0.5) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 0.5, xmax = n_species + 0.5, ymin = 5.5, ymax = 7, 
           fill = "#ffb347", alpha = 0.5) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 0.5, xmax = n_species + 0.5, ymin = 7, ymax = 12, 
           fill = "#ff6961", alpha = 0.5) +
  # Bars
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = iucn_colors, name = "IUCN Status") +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(
    title = "Fishing Exposure Index (FEI)",
    x = "Species",
    y = "FEI (log fishing hours)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right"
  ) +
  # Category labels with n and %
  annotate("text", x = 15, y = 2, 
           label = paste0("Low (n=", n_low, ", ", pct_low, "%)"), 
           hjust = 0, size = 3.5, fontface = "italic", color = "grey20") +
  annotate("text", x = 15, y = 4.75, 
           label = paste0("Moderate (n=", n_moderate, ", ", pct_moderate, "%)"), 
           hjust = 0, size = 3.5, fontface = "italic", color = "grey20") +
  annotate("text", x = 15, y = 6.25, 
           label = paste0("High (n=", n_high, ", ", pct_high, "%)"), 
           hjust = 0, size = 3.5, fontface = "italic", color = "grey20") +
  annotate("text", x = 15, y = 9, 
           label = paste0("Very high (n=", n_veryhigh, ", ", pct_veryhigh, "%)"), 
           hjust = 0, size = 3.5, fontface = "italic", color = "grey20")

# --- 2. SFEI bar plot (species ordered by increasing SFEI) ---
sfei_bar_data <- plot_data %>%
  arrange(SFEI) %>%
  mutate(species_order = row_number())

# Get range
n_species_sfei <- nrow(sfei_bar_data)
max_sfei <- max(sfei_bar_data$SFEI, na.rm = TRUE)
min_sfei <- min(sfei_bar_data$SFEI, na.rm = TRUE)

# Calculate n and % per SFEI category
n_underexposed <- sum(sfei_bar_data$SFEI <= 0)
n_moderate_over <- sum(sfei_bar_data$SFEI > 0 & sfei_bar_data$SFEI <= 1.96)
n_highly_over <- sum(sfei_bar_data$SFEI > 1.96)

pct_underexposed <- round(100 * n_underexposed / n_species_sfei, 1)
pct_moderate_over <- round(100 * n_moderate_over / n_species_sfei, 1)
pct_highly_over <- round(100 * n_highly_over / n_species_sfei, 1)

sfei_barplot <- ggplot(sfei_bar_data, aes(x = species_order, y = SFEI, fill = IUCN_label)) +
  # Background panels for SFEI categories
  annotate("rect", xmin = 0.5, xmax = n_species_sfei + 0.5, ymin = min_sfei - 1, ymax = 0, 
           fill = "#77dd77", alpha = 0.5) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 0.5, xmax = n_species_sfei + 0.5, ymin = 0, ymax = 1.96, 
           fill = "#fdfd96", alpha = 0.5) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 0.5, xmax = n_species_sfei + 0.5, ymin = 1.96, ymax = max_sfei + 5, 
           fill = "#ff6961", alpha = 0.5) +
  # Reference lines
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1.96, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "solid", color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.3) +
  # Bars
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = iucn_colors, name = "IUCN Status") +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(
    title = "Standardized Fishing Exposure Index (SFEI)",
    x = "Species",
    y = "SFEI (Z-score)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right"
  ) +
  # Category labels with n and %
  annotate("text", x = 15, y = min_sfei / 2, 
           label = paste0("Underexposed (n=", n_underexposed, ", ", pct_underexposed, "%)"), 
           hjust = 0, size = 3.5, fontface = "italic", color = "grey20") +
  annotate("text", x = 15, y = 6, 
           label = paste0("Moderately overexposed (n=", n_moderate_over, ", ", pct_moderate_over, "%)"), 
           hjust = 0, size = 3.5, fontface = "italic", color = "grey20") +
  annotate("text", x = 15, y = max_sfei * 0.7, 
           label = paste0("Highly overexposed (n=", n_highly_over, ", ", pct_highly_over, "%)"), 
           hjust = 0, size = 3.5, fontface = "italic", color = "grey20")

# --- 3. Combine plots ---
combined_barplots <- ggpubr::ggarrange(
  fei_barplot, sfei_barplot,
  ncol = 2, nrow = 1,
  common.legend = TRUE,
  legend = "bottom",
  labels = c("(A)", "(B)"),
  font.label = list(size = 14, face = "bold")
)

print(combined_barplots)

ggsave(
  here::here("R", "Outputs", "Fig_FEI_SFEI_species_barplots.png"),
  combined_barplots,
  width = 14, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = "white"
)

cat("Species barplots saved.\n")
```

## FEI and SFEI accross IUCN status
```{r}
#| label: fei-sfei-iucn-analysis
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| fig-width: 14
#| fig-height: 6

#======================
# FISHING EXPOSURE VS IUCN THREAT STATUS ANALYSIS
#======================

library(DescTools)
library(moments)
library(quantreg)

# Prepare data
fei_iucn_data <- SFEI_results %>%
  filter(!is.na(SFEI), !is.na(IUCN), !is.na(FEI_observed)) %>%
  mutate(
    IUCN_status = case_when(
      IUCN == 1 ~ "LC",
      IUCN == 2 ~ "NT",
      IUCN == 3 ~ "VU",
      IUCN == 4 ~ "EN",
      IUCN == 5 ~ "CR",
      TRUE ~ "Unknown"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(IUCN_status != "Unknown")

# Define IUCN colors and order
iucn_colors <- c(
  "LC" = "#38AB38",
  "NT" = "#58AFFF",
  "VU" = "#FEC748",
  "EN" = "#FC7F3F",
  "CR" = "#D81E05"
)
iucn_order <- c("LC", "NT", "VU", "EN", "CR")

#======================
# 1. SUMMARY STATISTICS
#======================

cat("=== FEI SUMMARY STATISTICS BY IUCN STATUS ===\n\n")

fei_summary <- fei_iucn_data %>%
  group_by(IUCN_status) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_FEI = mean(FEI_observed, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_FEI = median(FEI_observed, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_FEI = sd(FEI_observed, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_FEI = min(FEI_observed, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_FEI = max(FEI_observed, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(factor(IUCN_status, levels = iucn_order))

print(fei_summary)

cat("\n=== SFEI SUMMARY STATISTICS BY IUCN STATUS ===\n\n")

sfei_summary <- fei_iucn_data %>%
  group_by(IUCN_status) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_SFEI = mean(SFEI, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_SFEI = median(SFEI, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_SFEI = sd(SFEI, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_highly_overexposed = round(100 * sum(SFEI > 1.96) / n(), 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(factor(IUCN_status, levels = iucn_order))

print(sfei_summary)

# Skewness
cat("\n=== DISTRIBUTION SHAPE (Skewness) ===\n")

skewness_fei <- fei_iucn_data %>%
  group_by(IUCN_status) %>%
  summarise(
    skewness_FEI = skewness(FEI_observed, na.rm = TRUE),
    skewness_SFEI = skewness(SFEI, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(factor(IUCN_status, levels = iucn_order))

print(skewness_fei)

#======================
# 2. NON-PARAMETRIC STATISTICAL TESTS
#======================

cat("\n=== NON-PARAMETRIC STATISTICAL TESTS ===\n")

# --- FEI Tests ---
cat("\n--- FEI TESTS ---\n")

# Jonckheere-Terpstra test (for increasing trend: do more threatened species have higher FEI?)
cat("\n1. JONCKHEERE-TERPSTRA TEST (FEI ~ IUCN, increasing):\n")
jt_fei <- JonckheereTerpstraTest(fei_iucn_data$FEI_observed,
                                  fei_iucn_data$IUCN,
                                  alternative = "increasing")
print(jt_fei)

# Spearman correlation
cat("\n2. SPEARMAN RANK CORRELATION (FEI ~ IUCN):\n")
spearman_fei <- cor.test(fei_iucn_data$IUCN,
                          fei_iucn_data$FEI_observed,
                          method = "spearman")
print(spearman_fei)

# KS test (LC vs CR)
cat("\n3. KOLMOGOROV-SMIRNOV TEST (FEI: LC vs CR):\n")
ks_fei <- ks.test(
  fei_iucn_data$FEI_observed[fei_iucn_data$IUCN_status == "LC"],
  fei_iucn_data$FEI_observed[fei_iucn_data$IUCN_status == "CR"]
)
print(ks_fei)

# --- SFEI Tests ---
cat("\n--- SFEI TESTS ---\n")

# Jonckheere-Terpstra test
cat("\n1. JONCKHEERE-TERPSTRA TEST (SFEI ~ IUCN, increasing):\n")
jt_sfei <- JonckheereTerpstraTest(fei_iucn_data$SFEI,
                                   fei_iucn_data$IUCN,
                                   alternative = "increasing")
print(jt_sfei)

# Spearman correlation
cat("\n2. SPEARMAN RANK CORRELATION (SFEI ~ IUCN):\n")
spearman_sfei <- cor.test(fei_iucn_data$IUCN,
                           fei_iucn_data$SFEI,
                           method = "spearman")
print(spearman_sfei)

# KS test (LC vs CR)
cat("\n3. KOLMOGOROV-SMIRNOV TEST (SFEI: LC vs CR):\n")
ks_sfei <- ks.test(
  fei_iucn_data$SFEI[fei_iucn_data$IUCN_status == "LC"],
  fei_iucn_data$SFEI[fei_iucn_data$IUCN_status == "CR"]
)
print(ks_sfei)

#======================
# 3. QUANTILE REGRESSION
#======================

cat("\n=== QUANTILE REGRESSION ANALYSIS ===\n")

quantiles <- seq(0.3, 0.9, by = 0.1)

# --- FEI Quantile Regression ---
qr_fei_results <- data.frame()

for (tau in quantiles) {
  tryCatch({
    qr_model <- rq(FEI_observed ~ IUCN, tau = tau, data = fei_iucn_data)
    qr_summary <- summary(qr_model, se = "boot", R = 500)
    coef_table <- qr_summary$coefficients
    
    temp_result <- data.frame(
      Quantile = paste0("Q", tau * 100),
      Tau = tau,
      Slope = coef_table[2, 1],
      SE = coef_table[2, 2],
      t_value = coef_table[2, 3],
      p_value = coef_table[2, 4]
    )
    
    qr_fei_results <- rbind(qr_fei_results, temp_result)
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat(paste("Error at tau =", tau, ":", e$message, "\n"))
  })
}

qr_fei_results$Significant <- ifelse(qr_fei_results$p_value < 0.05, "Yes*", "No")

cat("\nFEI Quantile Regression Results:\n")
print(qr_fei_results)

# --- SFEI Quantile Regression ---
qr_sfei_results <- data.frame()

for (tau in quantiles) {
  tryCatch({
    qr_model <- rq(SFEI ~ IUCN, tau = tau, data = fei_iucn_data)
    qr_summary <- summary(qr_model, se = "boot", R = 500)
    coef_table <- qr_summary$coefficients
    
    temp_result <- data.frame(
      Quantile = paste0("Q", tau * 100),
      Tau = tau,
      Slope = coef_table[2, 1],
      SE = coef_table[2, 2],
      t_value = coef_table[2, 3],
      p_value = coef_table[2, 4]
    )
    
    qr_sfei_results <- rbind(qr_sfei_results, temp_result)
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat(paste("Error at tau =", tau, ":", e$message, "\n"))
  })
}

qr_sfei_results$Significant <- ifelse(qr_sfei_results$p_value < 0.05, "Yes*", "No")

cat("\nSFEI Quantile Regression Results:\n")
print(qr_sfei_results)

#======================
# 4. VISUALIZATIONS
#======================

# Calculate sample sizes for labels
n_per_category <- fei_iucn_data %>%
  group_by(IUCN_status) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(factor(IUCN_status, levels = iucn_order))

x_labels <- paste0(iucn_order, "\n(n=", n_per_category$n, ")")

# --- Panel A: FEI by IUCN ---
panel_fei <- ggplot(fei_iucn_data,
                     aes(x = factor(IUCN_status, levels = iucn_order),
                         y = FEI_observed)) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = IUCN_status),
              width = 0.15,
              size = 1.5,
              alpha = 0.6) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean,
               geom = "point",
               size = 3,
               color = "black") +
  stat_summary(fun.data = function(x) {
    mean_val <- mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)
    se_val <- sd(x, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(x)))
    return(data.frame(y = mean_val,
                      ymin = mean_val - se_val,
                      ymax = mean_val + se_val))
  },
  geom = "errorbar",
  width = 0.15,
  color = "black") +
  scale_color_manual(values = iucn_colors) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = x_labels) +
  labs(
    x = "IUCN Red List threat status",
    y = "FEI (log fishing hours)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10)
  )

# --- Panel B: SFEI by IUCN ---
panel_sfei <- ggplot(fei_iucn_data,
                      aes(x = factor(IUCN_status, levels = iucn_order),
                          y = SFEI)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1.96, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = IUCN_status),
              width = 0.15,
              size = 1.5,
              alpha = 0.6) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean,
               geom = "point",
               size = 3,
               color = "black") +
  stat_summary(fun.data = function(x) {
    mean_val <- mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)
    se_val <- sd(x, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(x)))
    return(data.frame(y = mean_val,
                      ymin = mean_val - se_val,
                      ymax = mean_val + se_val))
  },
  geom = "errorbar",
  width = 0.15,
  color = "black") +
  scale_color_manual(values = iucn_colors) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = x_labels) +
  annotate("text", x = 5.4, y = 1.96, label = "p = 0.05", 
           color = "red", size = 3, hjust = 0) +
  labs(
    x = "IUCN Red List threat status",
    y = "SFEI (Z-score)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10)
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off")

# Combine panels
fig_fei_sfei_iucn <- ggarrange(
  panel_fei, panel_sfei,
  ncol = 2, nrow = 1,
  labels = c("(A)", "(B)"),
  font.label = list(size = 14, face = "bold")
)

print(fig_fei_sfei_iucn)

ggsave(
  here::here("R", "Outputs", "Fig_FEI_SFEI_by_IUCN.png"),
  fig_fei_sfei_iucn,
  width = 14, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = "white"
)

#======================
# 5. SUMMARY TABLE FOR MANUSCRIPT
#======================

cat("\n=== SUMMARY FOR MANUSCRIPT ===\n\n")

# Create combined summary table
summary_table <- fei_iucn_data %>%
  group_by(IUCN_status) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    FEI_mean = round(mean(FEI_observed, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    FEI_se = round(sd(FEI_observed, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()), 2),
    SFEI_mean = round(mean(SFEI, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    SFEI_se = round(sd(SFEI, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()), 2),
    pct_overexposed = round(100 * sum(SFEI > 1.96) / n(), 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(factor(IUCN_status, levels = iucn_order))

kable(summary_table,
      format = "html",
      col.names = c("IUCN", "n", "FEI mean", "FEI SE", 
                    "SFEI mean", "SFEI SE", "% Highly overexposed"),
      caption = "Fishing exposure metrics by IUCN threat status") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                full_width = FALSE)

# Save summary
write_csv(summary_table, here::here("R", "Outputs", "FEI_SFEI_by_IUCN_summary.csv"))

cat("\nAnalysis complete.\n")
```
